metadata.description: Agent skills that make an AI assistant a better guest on the web, a more careful engineer, and a kinder collaborator.

plugins.name: ethical-skills
plugins.description: All seven skills in one plugin.

plugins.name: fetch-rules
plugins.description: House rules for pulling data from other people's servers: read robots.txt, send an honest User-Agent, back off on 429 and 503, never work around a 403, and stay under 3 GB per source per night.

plugins.name: code-of-ethics
plugins.description: Applies the ACM Code of Ethics to computing work. Flags concrete issues in one or two sentences, cites the principle number, and suggests a fix. Also audits a design or answers questions about the Code.

plugins.name: no-generated-art
plugins.description: When a task needs names, icons, photos or art, the assistant searches open libraries made by people and does not generate anything.

plugins.name: wrap-up-timer
plugins.description: Reads the real clock during a coding session and tells you to wrap up after a set stretch (50 minutes by default), then again at a daily cap (90 minutes).

plugins.name: carbon-water-footprint
plugins.description: Estimates the carbon and water footprint of a session from its real token counts. Shows a small marker that goes from green to yellow to red for carbon and from one to three drops for water, with a Greenpeace donation link.

plugins.name: sarc-check
plugins.description: Before you send archival astrometry to the Minor Planet Center, checks which station codes belong to an archive on the SARC list and names the committee member to contact first.

plugins.name: no-ai-slop
plugins.description: Edits a draft into sharper, more human writing while keeping the writer's voice, or lists the AI patterns in it without rewriting. By Peter Yang, included unchanged under the MIT License.
